- Minimal arm: sample15 A0.1989573,23 A0.1648831,19 A0.1642527. No component spans exist by design; no honest component attribution is available for that arm.

### What the data supports

Typical A cost remains packet work, activation/full index validation and outbox/capture work; native I/O was small in this study. The larger uninstrumented tail was0.199s and the nested bundle reached0.2157s, while the gate reached0.2715s. The study therefore does not establish whether the gate tail was pre-existing variance, the extra peer fixture/context, harness contention, or additional D4 A work. No product remedy is selected. Send data for reviewer ruling (a/b/c) before editing product, changing scope, or running another acceptance selection.

## Facade fixture error reproduced and corrected, not rerun

After all measurement windows ended, a permanent control constructed TWO independent peers sequentially while the candidate stayed claimed. It reproduced the exact TypeError in new_request: repeated launch_binding('api') returned an instance without current launch provenance on the second use. The earlier one-peer controls could not catch this. Corrected the harness to reuse its own fixture-local managed API instance and have the independent worker perform a real queue release after brief activation, so it finishes the transport before another peer request. No product-owner cache or transaction state is added; the fixture TestCase owns this binding only. The timed peer operation now honestly includes that release.

Observed before fix:1 ERROR0.423s, TypeError at provenance['effective']. After fix:23 checkpoint controls OK2.487s and4 tail controls OK0.002s. Product hashes still frozen. No facade, structural or other gate rerun after this correction. The three old failed rows remain failures. Any new complete structural class run requires reviewer direction and a new honest harness provenance, not silent substitution.
